cross_check.trajectory_note: Both legs draw the same evoxc splitmix64 stream from one seed and one graph, so generation 1 must match exactly on the integer keys and within rtol=1e-05/atol=1e-06 on the float payload. Beyond it a float-reassociation difference between the backends can reorder a near-tied selection, so a final-state key mismatch is search-trajectory drift, not necessarily a kernel defect.
